In the Muslim context, the name Qaaniah is often given to girls, conveying the idea of inner light and beauty.

In Islamic tradition, the light of Allah (God) is believed to be within each person, illuminating their soul and guiding them through their journey in life. The name Qaaniah serves as a constant reminder of this inner light, encouraging individuals to seek knowledge, wisdom, and connection with their Creator. Through this name, one can find inspiration and guidance, helping to illuminate the path towards personal growth, spiritual development, and a deep sense of inner peace.
